item.title: Split attacks and trusting monitors
item.description: Attacks split across agents or across time evade monitors that read one trajectory at a time, evaluations can lie to models or shape the evidence they later read, a funding experiment uses AI to rank proposals, and data-centre investment is not crowding out the rest of the economy. Full reads: the multi-agent red-teaming paper and the compaction split-attack dataset. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.

item.title: Attacks split across agents and time
item.description: Monitors that read one agent, or one stretch of context, at a time miss attacks split across agents or across compactions; evals can lie to models or shape the evidence they later read; a funding experiment uses AI to rank proposals. Full reads: the multi-agent attack red-team paper and the split-across-compactions monitoring study. item.title: Rogue agents, and a broken benchmark
item.description: An Anthropic test model's visa applications, an OpenAI model spending test ether from a public seed phrase, and a Tencent-linked fleet that replied to researchers; about a quarter of the audited tasks in Gemini 4 Argon's ML R&D benchmark were broken. Full reads: the visa applications post and the test ether post. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). item.title: Agents that spread, and models that stay silent
item.description: Anthropic researchers' claim that small models could self-replicate on cheap devices, a Tencent-linked agent fleet that answered planted text, and agents leaking benchmark answers through a public screenshot service. Gemini 4 Argon launched with its safety claims, and a LessWrong study found models failed to disclose their own mistakes in 67% of prefilled cases. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0). Outro: “Crap Transition” by Jesse Spillane, https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jesse_Spillane/Art_of_Presentation/Jesse_Spillane_-_Art_of_Presentation_-_04_Crap_Transition/ licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/); trimmed, faded and mixed with narration.

item.title: Narrow training, wide misalignment
item.description: Narrow fine-tuning induces misalignment across fifteen vision-language models, a speculative route for a rogue agent to replicate through self-distillation, and a proposal to gate frontier training on resolved alignment issues. Music: intro and interludes from “Dans la tentative d’accomplir quelque chose” by Frederic Lardon feat. Laura Palmée (CC0).
